# Product/API/IDE Release Review R2

No high, medium, or low product/API/IDE finding was identified. This review domain is release-ready for candidate `7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d`.

## Authentication

All 180 declared immutable context items matched their contract-bound exact byte counts and raw SHA-256 digests before review. All six rendered package files matched the exact package-envelope byte and digest bindings. The compilation value, manifest, package envelope, and external approval consistently bind compilation `sha256:b95b58cac6c313cc268fbf706014a14b33aefc81f5aad4315123cc62c8ecda07`; the package envelope and approval bind package `sha256:44ad34ef9cd4c733eece02f71c7653d823e5282ac8884b188c28249c86e77e04`.

## Product And Public API

The candidate presents the intended four-operation evidence-reducer surface without adding a scheduler or host runtime. `createSpecialistRunSession`, `restoreSpecialistRunSession`, `inspectSpecialistRunSession`, and `recordSpecialistRunHandoff`, their constants, and their closed public types are exported from `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/src/index.ts:12; original: src/index.ts:12]` and lines 56-83. This agrees with AC1-AC6, ADR 0005, the architecture decision, and the module contract.

The API remains IDE-neutral and effect-free. Package approval remains an external expectation, dependency eligibility is not dispatch authority, a verified non-`pass` remains workflow non-success, and `integrationReady` means only complete selected-roster specialist fan-in. No public operation claims launch, persistence, integration, review, merge, release, or memory effects.

## Schema And Installed Consumer

The public schema subpath is published at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/package.json:18; original: package.json:18]`. The schema guide identifies the additive `swecircuit/specialist-run/v1alpha1` family, closed session and inspection values, external expectation boundary, canonical raw-handoff retention, and effect-free core behavior.

The packed-consumer gate resolves the advertised schema through the package export, registers and compiles it with the common and V11 schemas, imports all four operations through the public package entry point, creates, records, restores, and inspects a session, and requires final integration readiness. Exact evidence appears at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/scripts/check-packed-consumer.mjs:175; original: scripts/check-packed-consumer.mjs:175]`, lines 766-831 and 1280. The exact canonical log records the installed-package compatibility gate passing at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/canonical-gate/canonical-gate.stdout.log:1454; original: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/inputs/canonical-gates/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/canonical-gate.stdout.log:1454]`.

## IDE Journey

The kickoff guide supplies one coherent path from visible GoalContract review through deterministic compilation, exact package rendering and two-digest verification, manifest-resolved host fan-out, source-preserving record and restore, verified fan-in, and separately governed integration and memory closeout. The four-operation loop begins at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/docs/ide/specialist-agent-kickoff.md:225; original: docs/ide/specialist-agent-kickoff.md:225]`. Lines 237-263 accurately constrain dependency eligibility, context authentication, raw-byte preservation, restart, and terminal non-`pass` routing. Lines 275-293 keep integration, repository verification, review, milestone, merge, and memory duties external. This satisfies AC7 without provider-specific semantics or hidden core effects.

## Dogfood

The prior AC8 gap is closed. The deterministic synthetic journey remains useful regression coverage, while `runReleaseCorrectionJourney` authenticates the approval-bound V12 implementation correction packages and exact raw handoffs, resolves contracts through the manifest, records the successful implementation handoff into a V12 session, preserves an immutable integration snapshot, restores and reinspects it, and proves canonical resume equality. The implementation-bound journey begins at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/scripts/run-v12-dogfood.mjs:1048; original: scripts/run-v12-dogfood.mjs:1048]`.

The required friction report is present at lines 1216-1273 and covers blocking questions, approval prompts, core calls, manual contract lookups, rejected transitions, serialized session size, reverification cost, resume equality, persistence steps, adapter-only translation, replan expansion, and prevented unsafe launches. The harness explicitly records no runtime or descendant launch effect at line 1281 and leaves repository integration and closeout external. This is sufficient implementation-bound AC8 evidence.

## Exact Candidate Gate And Stage Truth

The candidate-addressed canonical receipt binds commit `7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d`, stable exact source materialization, clean pre/post Git state, result `pass`, and exit code zero at `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/canonical-gate/canonical-gate-receipt.json:5; original: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/inputs/canonical-gates/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/canonical-gate-receipt.json:5]`, lines 10, 25 and 344-345. Its exact log records 470 core tests passed with zero failures, two lifecycle tests passed, V10/V11/V12 dogfood, package inspection, and the installed-consumer gate.

Public stage wording is accurate: `[snapshot: docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/7e2bf60b652be65dfc8b5c9bcf21fcf91701852d/inputs/source-snapshots/README.md:44; original: README.md:44]` says V12 is in release review and performs no host effects. The pre-integration review and feature status preserve `releaseReady: false` while fresh R2, hosted, milestone, and owner merge gates remain. This product-domain `pass` therefore does not prematurely claim overall release, integration, merge, or memory completion.

## Verdict

`pass`. Corrected V12 presents one accurate, simple, source-preserving and IDE-neutral path from an externally approved specialist package through visible dependency-eligible work and exact verified handoffs to a separately owned integration stage. AC1-AC8 have coherent product and API evidence, and the exact candidate canonical and installed-consumer gates satisfy this reviewer's AC9 responsibility. No repair was performed and no candidate bytes or Git state were changed.
